description: Check on, or wait for, an image / video / speech task that generate_image, generate_video or text_to_speech handed back as "still running". Returns the result URL(s) once it has finished (with an image preview for image tasks), a failure message if it failed, or "still running" again — in which case call get_task once more. Waits up to wait_seconds before answering, so one call usually suffices for a task that is nearly done. Task ids also appear at https://apimodels.app/console/records.

return_image.description: For image tasks, attach a downscaled preview of the result. Set false to save context.

task_id.description: The task id from the "STILL RUNNING" message (or from the apimodels console).

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the task before returning a task id instead (seconds, 0–900). Default 50: Codex aborts tool calls at 60 s unless tool_timeout_sec is raised. In Claude Code / Claude Desktop you can pass up to 900 to get the URL in one call.

name: get_task
